questions: Have you ever been diagnosed with a thyroid problem or hyperthyroidism?
Have you noticed any recent changes in your weight, heat tolerance, or heart rate?
Do you have double vision, especially when looking to the side?
Are your eyes red, painful, or gritty?
Has your vision blurred or decreased recently?
Do you smoke, or have you ever smoked?
Did the eye prominence develop gradually over months, or more suddenly?
Do you have a tremor, or do you feel unusually anxious or warm?
Has a family member ever had thyroid or eye problems like this?
Do you have any shortness of breath, leg swelling, or difficulty climbing stairs?
Have you had any recent illness, sinus problems, or facial trauma?
Do you have any history of cancer, sarcoidosis, or autoimmune disease?

DIAGNOSIS: Euthyroid Graves' orbitopathy (autoimmune, seronegative)

1. Bilateral IgG4-related orbital disease
2. Bilateral orbital lymphoma
3. Idiopathic orbital inflammation (atypical seronegative, non-inflammatory phase)
